posts.body:
Hello, I am new In the RPG Maker community.
While reading some threads on this forum, I learned that there Is a thing called Parallax Mapping, which allows you to make much more detailed maps for your projects than what normal RPG Maker MZ has to offer.
I also read that you can draw your own maps using softwares like Krita, and then export them to RPG Maker; My question Is precisely that:
What would be a good resolution size for a drawn map, Is there a maximum resolution size for one?
